correctness.rationale: A connected allocation exists and the budget binds by homogeneity. The simple graph makes the grounded-Laplacian map injective; the logdet second derivative is minus a squared Frobenius norm, so uniqueness forces the two edge-orbit weights without imposing symmetry. The nonzero even Fourier modes contribute m^2 a^(m-1), the odd modes 2 a^m[T_m(1+t)+1], and dividing by 2m gives the tree formula. The log objective is strictly concave in b along the budget line; the increasing t reparameterization preserves derivative signs. At the cycle boundary the derivative in t is [m^2-(2m-1)q]/2, including unique deletion at equality. As t goes to infinity the design disconnects. For fixed q the stationarity equation bounds t above, and t cannot tend to zero: tanh(m u/2)/sinh(u) then grows at least at order min(m,1/u), where u=arcosh(1+t), against a bounded right-hand side. The positive-root limiting quadratic agrees with the formula. At t=s^2/(2m^2) the scaled derivative tends to tanh(s/2)/s-alpha, supplying the stated brackets including the zero scaled limit at alpha=1/2, where exact eventual deletion is not asserted. Inspected RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md and verify.py; the reported 815 finite checks are supplementary and were not rerun.
